content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and others face significant obstacles when trying to sell their products online. Conventional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe often restrict access, leaving many without viable options. GitHub Pages offers a solution by providing free, reliable hosting for digital product stores without these limitations. This breakdown will lay out how to leverage GitHub Pages for hosting your digital products seamlessly and affordably.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that allows you to host your digital product store for free. This is particularly significant for creators in regions where traditional payment processors are not available. By utilizing GitHub Pages, you can build an online store without incurring the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on each sale. Instead, by integrating NOWPayments, you can process payments with just a 0.5% fee, allowing you to retain more of your sales revenue and invest it back into your business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-4|The Real]]-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-11|architecture]] of GitHub Pages utilizes a combination of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to serve your digital products. You can create a visually appealing storefront that functions without the need for a back-end server. By integrating Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate product deliveries and payment processing. This means once a customer pays, the system delivers their digital product instantly, ensuring a smooth user experience. The architecture is straightforward, allowing creators to focus on their products rather than the complexities of traditional e-commerce platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-3|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] is specifically designed for digital creators who have been excluded from mainstream payment platforms due to geographical restrictions or business models. If you create and sell ebooks, templates, software, or other digital assets, GitHub Pages allows you to set up your store with ease. With the ability to accept cryptocurrency payments via NOWPayments, you can cater to a global audience without the constraints of traditional payment methods, ensuring you can monetize your creativity regardless of where you are located.
GitHub Pages provides a cost-effective hosting solution for digital stores.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully deploy a digital product store on GitHub Pages, several components work in harmony. First, GitHub Pages hosts your website, making it accessible to potential customers. Integrating NOWPayments allows for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring low fees and no KYC requirements. Using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers automates the delivery of digital products after purchase. This fully operational stack requires no ongoing subscriptions and grants you total ownership of your sales and customer data, unlike platforms that control your revenue.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your GitHub Pages digital store, first, create your GitHub account and set up a new repository. Use the provided templates to build your storefront, and customize it to fit your brand. After deploying your site, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to handle transactions efficiently. Finally, test your setup to ensure that payments and automatic product deliveries work seamlessly. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments minimizes transaction fees, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook online by using GitHub Pages to host your store and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This way, you avoid the restrictions of traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Using GitHub Pages along with NOWPayments is the most efficient way to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees, allowing you to retain a larger percentage of your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you can sell templates and fonts directly without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
How do I automate digital product delivery?
You can automate digital product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which will handle the delivery of your products instantly after payment confirmation.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse audience with different payment preferences while keeping transaction fees low.
Automating product delivery enhances customer satisfaction and increases sales.
